name: Underbelly Scales
summary: In Redridge, Verner Osgood needs black dragon whelp scales to pay his debt to Smith Argus of Goldshire. You gather them from young drakes south of Lakeshire, and the scales settle Verner’s account with raw hide left for a piece of gear.

sections.title: A Frontier Debt
sections.body: Verner Osgood runs a forge outside Lakeshire and trades with craftsmen beyond the Redridge Mountains. Smith Argus of Goldshire sent him horseshoes, but Verner lacks the coin to pay. Argus asks for dragonhide instead: the softer underbelly scales of the black dragon whelps in the region. Without them, collectors may come from Elwynn Forest to claim the debt.

sections.title: Brood of the Black Flight
sections.body: Black dragon whelps trouble the defenders of the Redridge Mountains. Gnolls and orcs contest the roads, while the Black Dragonflight nests in the high peaks. Its brood wanders the skies south of Lake Everstill. The young predators’ underbelly scales are tough yet pliable, prized by armorers, smiths, and leatherworkers across the kingdom who dare to harvest them.

faq.q: Why does Verner Osgood need dragon scales?
faq.answer: Verner owes Smith Argus of Goldshire for a shipment of horseshoes. Argus asks for black dragon whelp underbelly scales instead of coin, and Verner needs them quickly before collectors come to enforce the debt.

faq.q: Where are the black dragon whelps found in Redridge?
faq.answer: Black dragon whelps roam the rocky crags and valleys south of Lakeshire. They cross the southern foothills, and hunters patrol the trails and ridges to spot them in flight.
Smith Argus is the blacksmith in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. He provides metalwork and forged goods to nearby settlements, including the horseshoes he sent to Verner Osgood in Redridge.

faq.q: Why are black dragon whelps in Redridge Mountains?
aliases: why are there dragons in redridge
faq.answer: The Black Dragonflight keeps a presence throughout the Burning Steppes and the peaks around Redridge. Its whelps hunt and wander south through the mountain passes into the Redridge foothills.

Underbelly scales are supple and flexible, unlike the thick, rigid scales along a drake’s back. They resist heat and punctures, making them useful for specialized leatherworking, tailored reinforcement, and exotic trade goods.

faq.q: Does clearing this debt lead to other tasks for Verner?
faq.answer: After you bring Verner Osgood his horseshoe shipment, he asks for these scales. Alongside this optional gathering, he sends adventurers to hunt gnoll scouts and leaders as the threat in Redridge grows.

angles.text: Smith Argus’s demand shows how smiths barter rare materials like dragon scales when coin is scarce.
The Black Dragonflight’s growing threat south of Lakeshire adds to the burdens on Redridge’s already overstretched garrison.
As a human, you know trade routes between Elwynn and Redridge supply towns like Lakeshire. Frontier craftsmen often pay steep prices to city merchants.
